title: Sitemap Snapshot Audit and Change Diff to JSON

publicDataOnly.title: Public non-personal permitted input only
publicDataOnly.description: Keep checked to confirm the documents are public, permitted to process, and contain no personal data. Runs with this unchecked are rejected (not charged). This is a policy acknowledgement, not automated PII detection.

sitemapUrls.title: Sitemap URLs
sitemapUrls.description: Public sitemap.xml locations (urlset or sitemapindex, up to 5 in total together with pasted documents). Each entry is a URL string or an object {"url": "https://...", "previousUrl": "https://..."}; previousUrl is an optional older snapshot URL (e.g. an archived copy) to diff against. Each file is fetched by the Actor: at most 1 MiB (gzip accepted, decompressed size also capped), ports 80/443 only, no credentials in the URL, redirects limited to 3, 20-second timeout; URLs resolving to private/internal addresses are refused. Index sitemaps list their children and are never followed. Failed fetches are listed in the run summary and are not charged.

documents.title: Pasted documents (optional, up to 5 in total with URLs)
documents.description: Optional. Content you paste directly. Counts toward the 1-5 items per run together with the URL list. 1 MiB per XML snapshot, up to 5,000 entries each. Standard namespaced urlset/sitemapindex only. No gzip, sitemap recursion, live status requests or XML entities/DTDs. Index results list child sitemap references, never fetch them. previousXml is optional; types must match. Pricing: $0.005 per successful document + $0.00005/run start. XML entries/PDF chunks are nested, not separately charged. Total input under 8 MB.
